req.title: Return arbitrary status code
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /status/<code> with an HTTP response bearing the requested status code, for codes 100 through 599.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /status/<code> returns exactly the requested HTTP status code for codes 100-599. To achieve high mutation kill rate: (1) EP tests cover representative codes from each class (2xx, 4xx, 5xx); (2) BVA tests probe the exact boundaries 100 and 599, plus 99 and 600 as out-of-range; (3) NEG tests verify invalid/out-of-range codes return 400; (4) DT tests cover special codes with extra headers (301, 418) to catch mutations in code_map logic; (5) STC tests verify multiple HTTP methods work. All assertions use exact equality to catch operator-flip and constant-bump mutations.
